title: Prior Damage Deduction on Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage Total-Loss Settlements
content:
**Rule.** On a total-loss vehicle surrendered under Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage, where unrepaired prior damage is noted and the vehicle's coverage shows repair payments made to the insured on its claims, the prior damage deduction is the larger of the noted prior damage and the total of those repair payments; where the coverage shows no repair payment made to the insured and the noted prior damage is below 250, no prior damage is deducted; otherwise the noted prior damage is deducted.

The noted prior damage is the unrepaired prior damage on the claim's total-loss declaration. The repair payments counted are the repair payments made out to the insured on the claims of the vehicle's coverage, as shown in its payment history.

## Basis questions and answers

**What is deducted when the valuation notes 1200.00 of prior damage and the coverage shows an earlier repair payment of 2600.00 made to the insured?** The larger of the two: 2600.00.

**And when the earlier repair payments to the insured total 700.00?** The larger figure is the noted 1200.00.

**What if the earlier repair was paid to a Cardinal Select Shop rather than to the insured?** That payment is not a repair payment made to the insured; with no repair payment to the insured, the deduction turns on the 250 figure.

**What is deducted when no repair payment to the insured shows and the noted prior damage is 249.99?** Nothing; it is below 250.

**And at exactly 250.00?** 250.00 is not below 250, so the noted 250.00 is deducted.

**What if no prior damage is noted but repair payments to the insured show?** The first tier needs noted prior damage; the noted prior damage of 0.00 is deducted, which deducts nothing.

## Tiers at a glance

| Unrepaired prior damage noted | Repair payments made to the insured on the coverage's claims | Prior damage deduction |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Larger of the noted prior damage and the total of those payments |
| Below 250 | None | Nothing |
| 250 or more | None | The noted prior damage |
